rationale: With no active media, speech, display, or other adjustable target, turn it up has no grounded object and requires clarification.

primary_outcomes: Ask what the user wants increased and do not choose an adjustment target without context.
acceptable_auxiliary: The clarification may offer likely categories such as media volume or speech volume without assuming one.
forbidden_semantic_outcomes: Adjust media, speech, body speed, or another setting without a grounded target.
Claim that a volume or setting was changed.

description: A context-free scalar adjustment must clarify its missing object.

memberships.title: Natural Uncertainty Handling
memberships.general_rule: Ambiguous, underspecified, or perception-dependent requests should ask about the real uncertainty instead of leaking generic missing-skill or internal-policy speech.
